correctness.rationale: The almost-abelian bracket satisfies the anti-pre-Lie identities by Jacobi and −2=1 in characteristic three. The V×V torsion equation has t-component f∧(f∘T)=0; irreducibility excludes nonzero f over k. The remaining equation is C[T,C]=0, C=B−aI, with a,u free. If C=v⊗φ has rank one, φ(v)≠0 would make φ a rational left eigen-covector; φ(v)=0 would force φ(v)=φ(Tv)=0, despite v,Tv spanning V. Thus C is zero or invertible in the centralizer k[T]. Counting a,u,b by whether a,b are zero gives the rational rank polynomial. For full automorphisms, HT=sTH and nonzero trace force s=1; conjugation acts by u↦hu+(a−b)w. Off the diagonal one orbit per pair; on it zero and nonzero u give two, yielding the stated rank census and q³+q. On the preserving subscheme, diagonalizing T gives the squarefree ideal (xy,yz,wz). Its two off-diagonal planes meet the diagonal plane in distinct lines and each other at the origin. The free parameters increase dimensions by three. Odd Frobenius powers fix only diagonal points, and even powers give 3Q⁵−2Q⁴ by inclusion-exclusion. The zeta formula follows by summing the even-power correction to Q⁵. The upload was inspected, not executed; the split test is a model for the same distinct-eigenvalue preserving equation, not a check of the unrestricted extension-field scheme.
residual_risks: Nonzero trace is essential to the stated full automorphism argument; all extension and geometric counts are only for N(V)⊂V, not the full torsion scheme.

value.rationale: This is a complete rational classification for a natural irreducible almost-abelian family in the characteristic where a Lie bracket is itself anti-pre-Lie. The full conjugacy quotient distinguishes translation-equivalent and genuinely distinct maps, and the preserving-locus calculation identifies precisely how quadratic splitting adds components and points. The distinction between these arithmetic and geometric scopes matters; this is more than a reparametrization of the shared block equation.
residual_risks: No census is given for the unrestricted split scheme or the trace-zero automorphism quotient.
